scope: Non-blind text review of first32 native-order test samples; no score-based sample selection
basis: Predicted captions compared with official reference captions; images not manually inspected in this review
observations: Several scene/object categories agree with references, including surfing, clock towers, cattle, giraffes and birds.
Some descriptions retain the main category but invent or omit location and object details.

Clear category errors remain: index0 market described as kitchen; index14 train/bridge described as airport; index21 skiers described as people in suits; index25 teddy bears/piano described as a street.
